title.en: Action without Surrendering Yourself · Eight Languages

summary.en: Eleven essays and the standalone adversity study add complete German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean rewrites. A report-maker’s decisions lead from refusal and inner necessity to bodily limits, developing one’s own value, helping without taking over, and acting together without becoming a single subject. All nine dialogues with philosophical traditions remain intact. Existing Chinese and English prose is unchanged.
summary.zh: 十一篇主线与独立逆境专论新增德法西日韩完整重写。从不改一个数字写到真实的行动限制、自己的价值、不替别人立法，以及一起做事而不合成一个主体；九场传统对话与全部例子、限定完整保留。原有中英繁正文不变。
summary.zh-hant: 十一篇主線與獨立逆境專論新增德法西日韓完整重寫。從不改一個數字寫到真實的行動限制、自己的價值、不替別人立法，以及一起做事而不合成一個主體；九場傳統對話與全部例子、限定完整保留。原有中英繁正文不變。
